day.noActiveHabits: No habits on this day. Tap the pencil to add one.

empty.title: No habits yet
empty.body: Create your first habit, then tick it off each day you do it.

errors.unknown-format: This file isn’t a Habits or Daygraph backup.
errors.negative-habit: “{{name}}” is a negative habit in Daygraph (ticking it means a slip). Habits doesn’t support those.
errors.newer-version: This file comes from a newer version of the app. Update the app first.

import.title: Import data
import.mergeHint: Adds what’s missing, without removing anything.
import.replaceHint: Your current data is saved first, so you can restore it from Settings.
import.replaceConfirmBody_one: Your {{count}} habit and {{checks}} ticked days will be replaced by what’s in this file.
import.replaceConfirmBody_other: Your {{count}} habits and {{checks}} ticked days will be replaced by what’s in this file.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.progressSentenceVs: {{pct}} of days done in {{year}}, compared with {{others}}.
stats.tapHint: Tap a bar to see its value.
stats.weekdaysSentence: {{hardest}} is your hardest day, {{easiest}} your easiest (last 12 months).

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupHint: Export saves a file you can keep in Files or iCloud Drive. Import reads that file, or a Daygraph backup.
settings.clearAllHint: Development only. A copy is saved first, and can be restored above.
settings.clearAllConfirmBody: All habits and ticks will be deleted. A copy is saved first.
settings.remindersHint: No more reminders for the day once every habit is ticked. Each habit can also have its own reminders.
settings.notificationsDeniedHint: Turn them on in your phone’s settings
settings.noMailApp: No email app is set up on this phone.

habits.title: My habits
habits.intro: Drag a habit by its handle to reorder. Tap it to edit.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Phrase it so that ticking it means success: “No smoking” rather than “Smoking”.
form.remindersHint: No more reminders for the day once this habit is ticked.

archive.hint: It disappears from the day and the statistics. Its history is kept, and you can restore it from Archived.
archive.confirmBody: You can restore it at any time.

archived.intro: Swipe a habit to the left to delete it for good.
archived.deleteBody: All its history will be erased. This can’t be undone.

habits.editHint: Opens the habit to edit it

reminders.notificationBody: Some habits aren’t ticked yet today.

intro.title: One tap a day for your habits

tick.title: Tick off what you did
tick.body: Tap a habit once it’s done. Past days stay editable.

progress.title: Watch it add up
progress.body: Streaks and statistics for every habit.

reminder.title: A nudge, if needed
reminder.body: Reminders stop for the day once everything is ticked.
reminder.label: Remind me daily
